limitations: The doctor brief byte budget is asserted with the advisory burn scan disabled in the smoke fixture; whether the burn scan section should be bounded in brief view for live operator runs is a design question owned by the burn-scan feature, tracked separately. pitfalls: 1) A byte-budget assertion over output containing live machine state (session dirs) is nondeterministic — my first green run was luck; the round-2 reviewer failing it minutes later exposed it. Disable environment-dependent sections in fixtures via their documented env switches. 2) The failing combination was worktree-BUILT CLI + non-self cwd; a live doctor probe with the global CLI passes, so reproduce with the exact binary the failing suite uses before concluding anything. 3) story_update exists for title/description/priority edits at INIT (background_set for background.md); checklist context edits invalidate scope-freeze — rerun scope_freeze_check before INIT_CHECK.
